limitations: These are eight-step diagnostic windows; never use their wall time as acceptance throughput.
The same request trigger does not make concurrent batch schedules identical across modes.
Near4K prefill filters shapes and positions, but contexts, activations, sparse indices and companion requests still differ.
FULL-graph decode comparisons require matching live/padded query counts and batch; otherwise no ratio is emitted.
Eager decode is separately matched by node/live batch/query counts/padded execution tokens, with30/31 calls per phase. Actual contexts, values and cache addresses still differ.
Per-phase30/31 layer counts validate C4/C128 attribution. Unresolved exported flows remain unresolved.
Kernel sums, activity unions and HCCL/fused MoE intervals overlap; they cannot be added into request latency or pure wait time.
Node1 raw profiles remain on Node1; its parsed, hashed analysis is copied into the local run directory.
